summary: Oak Mountain, Saline County, Arkansas: Ouachita National Forest steel lookout tower built 1928 and marked removed in 1966; no source describes the summit today.

facts.status_note: Marked removed in 1966. A list of Mena and Oden ranger district lookouts says the site is no longer in existence; no source describes the summit now.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The build year (1928), the removal (1966) and the 1937 staffing mention all come from one page; the 1937 item is a Texas newspaper reprint quoted by that page and was not checked against the original. The argenweb list of Mena and Oden ranger district lookouts says the site is no longer in existence but gives no date. The 1940 NGS description gives 100 feet to the lookout-house floor, so height_m is 30.5 on the cab-floor basis the guide uses; the record had no height. The NGS listing has a second row for this mark coded NN; the story uses the XX row. No access or remains source found. Brief status (gone) and agency (Ouachita National Forest) match the sources. Verify with the Ouachita National Forest before publishing.
